profile.name: Nexi S.p.A.
profile.summary: Nexi S.p.A. provides electronic money and payment services to banks, small and medium-sized enterprises, large international corporations, institutions, and public administrations in Italy, Nordics and Baltics, Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Poland, Southeast Europe, and internationally. The company offers payment processing and acceptance services; configuration, activation, and maintenance of Point of Sales terminals; fraud prevention services; and dispute management services, as well as customer support and value-added services. It also provides various issuing services, such as issue, supply, and management of private and corporate payment cards; payment tracking and the production of monthly statements, data analysis and price-setting support services, customer service, and dispute management, as well as communication and customer development services; installation and management of Automated Teller Machines; clearing services; and digital banking services for the management of current accounts and payments. In addition, the company offers applications for invoice management and storage, prepaid card reloading, bill payments, and postal payments. The company was founded in 1939 and is based in Milan, Italy.
profile.summary_fr: Nexi S.p.A. fournit de la monnaie électronique et des services de paiement aux banques, aux petites et moyennes entreprises, aux grandes entreprises internationales, aux institutions et aux administrations publiques en Italie, dans les pays nordiques et baltes, en Allemagne, en Autriche, en Suisse, en Pologne, en Europe du Sud-Est et à l'international. La société offre des services de traitement et d'acceptation des paiements; configuration, activation et maintenance des terminaux de point de vente; services de prévention de la fraude; et des services de gestion des litiges, ainsi que du soutien à la clientèle et des services à valeur ajoutée. Il fournit également divers services d'émission, tels que l'émission, la fourniture et la gestion de cartes de paiement privées et d'entreprise; suivi des paiements et production de relevés mensuels, services d'analyse de données et de soutien à la fixation des prix, service à la clientèle et gestion des différends, ainsi que des services de communication et de développement de la clientèle; installation et gestion de guichets automatiques; services de compensation; et services bancaires numériques pour la gestion des comptes courants et des paiements.
